description: NaLuCl₄ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent LuCl₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.88 Å. Lu is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. There are a spread of Lu-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Lu atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Lu atoms.
